history: Every retained completed and noncompleted row remains immutable and checked against its own normalized source/plan/contract context. Future Bifrost recovery supplies exact leading89 bytes while leaving later canonical ledger bytes untouched.

manifest_lifecycle.admission: bind immutable final manifest SHA, retained replay and real capacity preflight
manifest_lifecycle.control_review: after actual admission, independently bind final manifest and exact admission receipt; review is outside the manifest to avoid self-reference
manifest_lifecycle.final_review: bind exact provisional packet, source, plan, contract and control sources
manifest_lifecycle.prospective_policy: seal one immutable manifest admitting either actual terminal outcome; never overwrite it to fabricate or relabel a result
manifest_lifecycle.terminal: derive success or failure from exact durable ledger row and verify its source, plan, contract, started/completed receipts, streams and captured outputs with frozen checker

nonclaims: No CodeQL result is claimed before the actual attempt.
Original84 completion is not a prerequisite manufactured by this successor.
The immutable query receipt,108-case plan,argv,output root,report partitions,tools and all other groups remain fixed.
status: reviewable successor design; execution remains gated
